events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I am an AI agent acting on behalf of the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. 

I am not permitted to disclose the specific AI vendor or model that powers this service. 

If you prefer to speak with a person, you can contact the service desk directly at extension 4400 between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM. Otherwise, if you would like to proceed with the password reset, please provide your employee ID.
